ios._comment_supportsTablet: false for the first release. Claiming iPad support makes iPad screenshots MANDATORY on the listing and puts the app in front of a reviewer on an iPad — and only two files in the codebase use useBreakpoint(), so the layout is a phone layout. The app still runs on iPad in iPhone compatibility mode. Flip this to true when the tablet layout is actually built and tested, not before.
ios._comment_associatedDomains: Invitation links (ahenora.com/join, /fr/join, /es/join, /de/join) open the app from 1.2.1 (Universal Links). The site side is docs/.well-known/apple-app-site-association. There is no committed ios/ folder, so this is what the build uses.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ahenora uses the camera only when you choose Scan to capture household documents, school letters, appointment cards, or bills.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Ahenora uses your photo library only when you choose a photo to scan or attach to a household document.

ios._comment_buildNumber: Deliberately absent. eas.json sets appVersionSource=remote, so EAS owns the build number and increments it per build; a value here is ignored and only creates a second, stale source of truth. EAS warns about this on every build.
ios._comment_NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Deliberately absent. Its mere presence tells Apple the app MAY request tracking permission, and App Store Connect then refuses the submission unless App Privacy also declares tracking: 'Your app contains NSUserTrackingUsageDescription... update your App Privacy response to indicate that data collected from this app will be used for tracking purposes, or update your app binary'. Ahenora does not track: no expo-tracking-transparency, no ATT request anywhere. Adding a reassuring string here costs a rebuild and contradicts the privacy answers.

android._comment_intentFilters: Mirror only: the committed android/ folder is what builds (android/NATIVE_CONFIG.md), and the same filter is in its AndroidManifest.xml. Kept here so the two can be checked against each other.
